digest.component_or_area: rich text reconciler cutover with echo-safety and state-based conflict handling
propositions: The live cutover must reroute description send and compare through rich codecs (ADF for Cloud, rendered wiki for DC) while preserving echo-safety via state-based three-way baseline comparison and the settled local-wins + conflict_sink conflict policy from story a713.

The description baseline directionality and conflict-detection compares must normalize the local side through the codec normalize_outbound so both operands sit in decoded space and lossy round-trip artifacts cancel, allowing legacy bodies to upgrade exactly once then converge; the emit compare must keep the plain inbound-decoded remote unchanged so it forces the one-time upgrade re-emit.

Redefining WikiTextCodec.normalize_outbound from identity to the rendering form must not shift the DC comment-diff dedup key, which must stay on the identity/plain normalizer to prevent duplicate comment re-posts.

The DC CREATE path must compose the renderer/to_wire with fit_outbound before sending so newly-created issues ship rendered wiki alongside the UPDATE path, both gated behind a single rollback flag that defaults OFF.

Outbound origin-gating must suppress sends when local equals baseline (no rebar edit), allowing Jira-native constructs authored with no rebar change to survive without re-encoding; a change-gated inline rich_sha must replace per-pass timestamps to maintain the ≤0.07 KB/version churn profile.

Concurrent both-sides description edits must keep rebar's body (local-wins) and raise the existing outbound-field-conflict bridge alert so the remote divergence is surfaced and never silently destroyed.
